title: VPN connection troubleshooting
sections: If the VPN times out, confirm general internet access, restart the VPN client, and retry on a different network. Escalate with the error code if the timeout persists.
If the VPN repeatedly asks you to sign in, check that your device clock is set automatically, then sign out and back in. Never include credentials in a support ticket.

title: Microsoft 365 authentication
sections: If you lost the phone registered for Microsoft 365 MFA, contact the service desk for identity verification and re-enrolment. Do not approve unexpected sign-in prompts.
Deny unexpected MFA prompts and report the time and account name to IT security.

title: Approved software requests
sections: Request software through the IT service desk. Include the application name, business justification, and device asset tag. IT checks licensing before installation.

title: Laptop equipment faults
sections: If your laptop will not boot or power on, reconnect its approved charger and try a working outlet. Submit the asset tag and charger indicator status to IT if the problem persists.

title: Suspicious email reporting
sections: Use the Report Phishing button in Outlook. If you entered credentials, contact IT security immediately and include the time of the incident.

title: Privileged recovery drill
sections: During the synthetic recovery drill, two IT duty officers verify the recovery case before opening the restricted recovery checklist. Exercise reference: SIM-RECOVERY-21.
